method.environment: Synthetic loopback PostgreSQL 16, 1 CPU/768 MiB; Node v24.15.0; API pool 8/concurrency 4, unchanged. Shared host. Timed cohorts sequential; no other task SQL/tests during timings.
method.fixtureReset: Dedicated empty loopback _test database guard, then VACUUM ANALYZE before seeding and ANALYZE after seeding for BOTH sources. No production vacuum. Cleaning prior synthetic DELETE footprints prevents dataset order from changing heap/TOAST size.
method.http: Predefined ABBA: previous integrated performance source/candidate/candidate/previous. 100 warm requests per route/profile, one fresh API process per cold route/profile, 16 reads after worker write. 11 positive pool buckets INCLUDING warmup; eight permission negatives checked separately.
method.service: Two predefined five-pair cohorts per shape/mode. First order sparse,dense; repeat dense,sparse. Alternating sources within each pair. Module imports and boot excluded; PostgreSQL pages warm. CPU deltas and initialization recorded separately. Profiles execute after timing.
method.stages: Source phases are reported in request stages. No admission semaphore, app queue, pool/concurrency/budget increase or new feature flag. Stage durations may overlap across callers; their sum is not HTTP elapsed time.
method.limits: Local synthetic acceptance only. No cold HTTP p95 with a single cold sample. No proxy/TLS/browser/real production load/24h/7-day acceptance inferred. No uniform incremental HTTP latency improvement claim.
